selection: All Tatoeba train; AISHELL train whole families sorted by SHA256(seed + TAB + family), take through the first family reaching the old train Han-character count; no duplicates or replacement
workload: Each sentence at cut 0 and floor(length / 2), empty personal lexicon, actual AdaptivePinyinDecoder whole candidates; midpoint uses previous two source characters, an oracle-context proxy

development.gate: Each domain: top1/top5/recall255 nondecreasing, total top1 Levenshtein errors nonincreasing; new domain top1 strictly increases. Record all individual first/rank losses.

test.opening: Only after development gate passes and input/model/configuration hashes are frozen; one pass, no further tuning
test.gate: Same per-domain nonregression and new-domain strict top1 gain as development; model size cap and repeated-output consistency. Passing offline gates still needs Android cost/lifecycle/privacy acceptance and data-notice packaging before deployment.

scope: Source reconstruction with agent-reviewed pinyin, not human typing accuracy; no HMM/CRF or neural-model claim. No new dictionary or score-weight trials in this experiment.
